summary: More logging fields: aggregator username and password or token, loggers to send (all four by default), cluster-wide unique identifier, protocol, TCP connection timeout, level threshold, action queue size, disk persistence in GB, spool directory (default /var/lib/awx) and the API 4XX log format.
questions: How do I choose which loggers send to the aggregator?
How do I set the log level threshold for external logging?
What is the cluster wide unique identifier in logging settings?
